name: 75762 · Flint, TX
findings: ZIP 75762 (Flint) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75762 (Flint) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75762 (Flint) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
